name: USGS updated geologic-materials XRD reference library
description: Measured powder diffractograms with reference intensity ratios, mineral-source metadata and paired corundum-spiked measurements.
count_scope: Counted156 named intensity columns in RJ_ComparisonMaterials_purePatterns.csv and156 rows in values table; companion spike patterns are not additional phase identities.
properties: reference intensity ratio relative to corundum

sources.title: ScienceBase primary release metadata
sources.evidence: Lists downloadable pure/spiked CSV patterns, RIR/source values, preparation-comparison data and FGDC XML; actual pure-pattern CSV has156 phase columns and3001 angle rows.

sources.title: USGS FGDC methods and attribute metadata
sources.evidence: Cu Kalpha patterns span5–65 degrees2theta at0.02degree spacing and at least5s/step. Instrument aligned with NIST-traceable quartz; corundum spikes define RIRs; trace impurity subtraction is documented.

sources.title: USGS release rights
sources.evidence: Provider explicitly marks the data release CC0 1.0 Universal.

caveats: A single specimen/preparation represents each phase label; solid solution and crystallinity change peak positions/intensities.
Measured reference patterns include documented trace-impurity subtraction and are not untouched detector output.
Original RockJock2003 had169 patterns; the inspected2021 pure-pattern file contains156. Do not use169 as this release count.
Mineral/source identities do not include solved atomic coordinates; repeated forms and natural/synthetic variants are separate references.

additional_counts.scope: Actual CSV rows from5.00 to65.00 degrees

name: NIST hafnia-on-silicon planar film metrology set
description: Spatially resolved X-ray reflectometry and spectroscopic ellipsometry for ALD hafnia films, with wafer/deposition provenance and preliminary thickness-model fits.
version: NIST mds2-3930 v1.0.1; README v1.0.0; CHIPS-6-02-25-00-set
count_scope: Twelve sister wafers across four deposition runs; full SE maps target four selected wafers and XRR coverage varies across wafers.
license: NIST data-use terms explicitly linked by release metadata; not a Creative Commons license

sources.title: NIST current primary release metadata
sources.evidence: Current version1.0.1 identifies12 wafers, downloadable raw RAS/RASX and SE formats, text model exports and instrument-alignment files; release history says v1.0.1 added the CHIPS collection.

sources.title: Hafnia release README and inspected text exports
sources.evidence: Documents65 ALD cycles on200mm Si, four runs/chamber positions, instrument models/serials and wafer mapping. Downloaded fit table labels X/Y(cm), thickness(nm), Cauchy parameters and individual Error columns. Fits assume one Cauchy layer over300–1000nm.

caveats: Small process-correlated wafer cohort;12 wafers are not12 chemistries or independent deposition batches.
Reported thickness parameters are preliminary single-layer Cauchy fits; fit errors are not a complete certified uncertainty budget.
XRR is intended to reduce SE uncertainty, while fuller maps and diced reference-material distribution are described as future work.
Some full instrument formats are proprietary; text exports and raw ASCII RAS provide reusable subsets.
README has a likely wafer typo24-04 while the deposition list says25-04; preserve original identifiers when reconciling.

name: NIST MgO ultraviolet atom-probe mass spectra
description: Binned MgO atom-probe spectra comparing extreme- and near-ultraviolet pulsing, with uncorrected, corrected and estimated-background counts.
version: NIST mds2-4005 v1.0.0; README2025, repository issued2026-01-16
count_scope: Ten distinct CSV files linked by current release metadata; each has40000 mass-bin rows and four columns. Not a count of unique materials or independent specimens.
license: NIST data-use terms explicitly linked by release metadata; not a Creative Commons license

sources.title: NIST primary release and checksums
sources.evidence: Provides ten downloadable spectra and checksums. Downloaded CSVs each have40000 rows, four headers and a0–399.99Da grid with0.01Da spacing; README documents count columns and binning.

sources.title: MgO spectra README
sources.evidence: Names EUV/NUV CSVs and units; openly links NIST data-use terms. Filenames preserve energy/source/detection-rate/repetition-rate condition labels.

caveats: One material(MgO); useful for mass-spectrometry processing and source-condition comparisons, not broad composition–property learning.
Negative corrected counts are present; preserve them and distinguish count correction/background modeling from raw counts.
README lists EUV_5T_1DR twice; current release actually has10 distinct spectra.
README says0.01–399.99Da, but each inspected payload includes a0Da row.

Detailed specimen histories, per-bin statistical uncertainties and calibration/ranging procedures are not supplied in the short README; filename codes need paper-level context for full interpretation.

name: NIST targeted-chemical-pressure Ruddlesden–Popper dielectric data
description: Experimental XRD and frequency-, temperature- and field-dependent dielectric curves for Ba-containing titanate superlattices, accompanied by computed crystal models.
count_scope: Distinct sample count was not established; verified release contains nine CSV tables and nine CIF models. Do not convert curve rows into independent materials.
license: NIST dataset-use permission explicitly stated in README; article-content reuse separately refers to publisher terms

sources.title: NIST primary release metadata
sources.evidence: Current version1.0.2 links nine CSV tables and CIF TGZ plus README; inspected archive contains9 CIFs(PE/FE variants for n2–6; n2_FE absent).

sources.title: Dataset README, schema and rights
sources.evidence: Provides variable-by-variable units/conditions: XRD degrees/counts; temperature K; frequency Hz; field kV/cm; film thickness and n. Dataset permission includes modification/distribution with acknowledgement and change notice; calibration details are delegated to the article methods.

caveats: Narrow engineered thin-film series; preserve layer number, film thickness, substrate/strain, temperature, frequency and applied field when comparing values.
CIFs and DFT distortion-energy curves are computed models; measured dielectric curves are a separate provenance layer.
Nine files or nine computed structures do not establish nine independently measured materials.
README delegates calibration to article methods; a complete measurement uncertainty budget was not independently reconstructed.
CSV tables include multi-curve columns and blanks; preserve column-specific units and avoid treating every cell as an independent sample.

additional_counts.scope: Downloaded TGZ inventory; not experimental sample count
